Change c0545. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): But, in the detail which he gave you of them, he could not sum up the hours and months of misery which I endured, wasting in impotent passions.

1818 text: For whilst I destroyed his hopes, I did not satisfy my own desires.

1831 text: For while I destroyed his hopes, I did not satisfy my own desires.

Diff: For [-whilst-] {+while+} I destroyed his hopes, I did not satisfy my own desires.

Context after (unchanged): They were for ever ardent and craving; still I desired love and fellowship, and I was still spurned.

result.rationale: Swaps the archaic conjunction 'whilst' for 'while' with no change in meaning; a diction-level change of the same sense, not an orthographic or substantive one.
